newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN GAS FIRM'S Q1 NET PROFIT 19 MILLION LITAS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN GAS FIRM'S Q1 NET PROFIT 19 MILLION LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's state-run gas company, Lithuanian Gas, said on Monday that its net profit for the first three months of this year was 19 million litas compared to 20 million litas for the same period in 1996.

"We had a net profit of 19 million litas in the first quarter of this year...we always make a profit in the first and fourth quarters during the heating season," Kestutis Shumacheris, the company's general director, told Reuters.
The company posted losses of almost 16 million litas for 1996 after the Lithuanian government agreed to assume responsibility for its debts to Russian suppliers.
Shumacheris said that the company would use 16 million litas of its first quarter profit to compensate for its 1996 losses and the rest will be used for repair works on its supply system.
He added that the company would only finish all of 1997 with a profit if gas prices are raised.
"We are talking to the government's price commission about the increase...but it is premature to say how much it will be," he said, but added that it is expected to come into force on July 1.
Lithuanian Gas is around 90 percent state-owned and its private shares are traded on the A list of the Vilnius bourse.
